fallacies.name: ad baculum
fallacies.description: In an appeal to fear (argumentum ad baculum), the arguer pressures the audience by highlighting threats or frightening outcomes, rather than supporting the conclusion with relevant evidence or reasoning.
fallacies.generation_prompt: You are an expert in argumentation. Write one short argument (3-5 sentences) about immigration policy that clearly commits the appeal to fear fallacy: it tries to make the audience accept a claim by threatening or suggesting frightening negative consequences instead of giving good evidence. Do not mention the word 'fallacy', do not explain the reasoning, just output the argument.

evaluation_prompts.detection:
Read the following argument:
"{{TEXT}}"
Does the argument actually contain any fallacies?
FALLACY: [YES/NO]
EXPLANATION: [1-2 sentences]
